description: This file defines a React functional component 'RoleManagement' which provides a frontend interface for managing user roles in an admin page. It includes CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete) using local state, with a searchable and editable table, modal dialogs for editing roles, and UI controls for interaction.

methods.name: resetForm
methods.description: Resets the form state to initial empty values and clears editing state.

methods.name: openAdd
methods.description: Prepares the form for adding a new role and displays the modal dialog.

methods.name: openEdit
methods.description: Prepares the form for editing an existing role and displays the modal dialog.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Removes a role from the local state by its ID.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission for creating or updating a role, with basic validation.
